title: Quickieweb is being built in the open
dek: Early, unfinished, and running on itself from the first day.
pullQuote: The platform's own site is a site on the platform. If it cannot build this page, it cannot build yours.
body:
This page is served the same way every Quickieweb site is: rendered once, written to object storage, handed to a CDN. There is no separate marketing stack, no CMS behind it, and no server answering this request.

That is on purpose. A platform whose own site runs on something else is telling you something, and it is not flattering.

Where it is

Working today: the template engine and its validator, design tokens, static pages, multi-site provisioning, per-site membership, and publishing.

Not yet: public sign-up, custom domains, and per-site 404 pages. Those are named because a roadmap that only lists wins is a brochure.
